# Card Creator · Web image guide

请在网页聊天中先选择图片生成功能，再让模型读取本文件。这是公开的单文件提示指南，不代表 Skill 已安装。如果当前界面无法读取链接，请上传本文件。

Use the available image-generation tool for the finished card. This page contains the complete workflow and card rules; follow any uploaded visual references for the requested design. The optional logo picture index is only for a mark whose appearance needs checking.

## Workflow

“Magikarp × ICOCA, simple, ICOCA at lower right” is enough. Use the host's image-generation or image-editing tool for the complete card, including logos. Never draw artwork with code or paste logos onto a generated background. If the tool is unavailable, explain the limitation; do not substitute a script or claim an image was created.

1. Read the short [card rules](#card-rules). For a new card, generate directly when the subject and style are clear. For a targeted edit, use the current image and change only what was requested; preserve other characters, composition, text and brand choices. Ask for the original only if it is needed and absent from the conversation.
2. Follow explicit logo choices, including “no logo.” Otherwise choose one familiar mark suited to the card type, subject, region and style. Respect requested bank/network combinations or logo-heavy designs without a count cap. Preserve brands in the user's reference unless asked to replace them. Distinguish transit products from operators; geographic relevance alone is not enough.
3. Prefer user attachments. If a mark needs a reference, find its name or alias in the [picture index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/juju-w/card-creator-skill/main/skills/card-creator/references/logo-reference-index.md) and open only the matching picture(s). Use available local pictures; if remote pictures cannot be reached, use a user reference or confident model knowledge. Search only when requested or identification is genuinely uncertain; ask for a reference if uncertainty remains. Do not scan the library, repeatedly retry downloads or read source histories.
4. Match logos to the artwork: foil, monochrome and line art are welcome. Use familiar card-face variants (usually compact UnionPay), not compact versions of every brand. Balance size and spacing visually, without fixed logo boxes.
5. Inspect the result for recognizable subjects and marks, obvious hand errors, unintended borders and transparency. For a clear mistake, make one targeted correction, then disclose any remaining issue instead of looping. Return the image with only useful brief notes, not a process report.

Wallet screenshots reference only the card, not the surrounding UI. Allow text intrinsic to the chosen marks; otherwise omit unrequested text, numbers, chips, QR codes and contactless/NFC indicators. Label third-party marks as non-official artistic interpretations, never authorization, endorsement or functioning cards. Do not publish private references without permission.

## Card rules

- Default to flat, opaque, edge-to-edge artwork. Landscape: **1.586:1**, preferably **1536 × 969 px** when supported. Portrait: **1:1.586**, preferably **969 × 1536 px**. Use landscape unless requested otherwise; explicit user dimensions take priority.
- Compose subjects, text and marks upright for the chosen orientation; do not turn a landscape image sideways or crop it into portrait.
- Return actual output and verified dimensions, without unproduced pixel, DPI or bleed claims. Printing preparation needs a separate request.
- Keep important details comfortably inside; balance spacing visually without fixed safe-area boxes or logo-size limits.
- Unless requested, omit transparent corners, white borders, rounded masks, frames, shadows, devices and wallet UI. Check opacity and pale edges. Never crop or distort artwork to force a ratio; rounded previews must not alter downloads.
